How to install an Android APK
  1. When a release is available, download the correct app on your Android phone.
  2. Open the downloaded APK. If prompted, allow this browser to install unknown apps.
  3. Tap Install, then open the app. Turn off that installation permission afterwards.

Only install official DHW-inRide releases linked here. For a Google Play release, follow the store’s installation steps.
